caption: The drawing features a composition of four crescent-shaped objects, each nested within the other and suspended vertically in alignment, resembling a mobile. The crescents decrease in size from top to bottom and are connected by small circular links. At the top of the composition, there is a thin, vertical element possibly representing a hook or hanging mechanism. The objects are rendered in a dark brown or black color, with visible highlights that suggest a metallic or polished surface. The background is a plain, light beige or off-white color, providing contrast to the dark forms. Near the bottom right corner, there is a small, hand-written signature, rendered in black ink.
title: Blacksmith's Sign
